title: Strong coupling expansion of $1\over 2$ BPS Wilson loop in SYM theory and 2-loop Green-Schwarz string in AdS$_5 \times $S$^5$
summary: The exact localization result for the expectation value of the $1\over 2$ BPS circular Wilson loop in ${\cal N}=4$ SYM theory is given in the planar limit by the famous Bessel function expression: $\langle W\rangle = {2N\over \sqrt λ} I_1 ( \sqrt λ)$. Expanded in large $λ$ and expressed in terms of the AdS$_5 \times $S$^5$ string tension $T= {\sqrt λ\over 2π}$ this gives $\langle W\rangle = {\sqrt T\over 2πg_s} e^{2πT} (1- {3\over 16 π} T^{-1} + ...)$.The exponential is matched by the value of the action of the string with the AdS$_2$ world volume while the prefactor comes from the 1-loop GS…
